stem.text: What is the correct sequence of events in a primary immune response?

A.text: T-lymphocyte activation → B-lymphocyte selection → plasma cell release

B.text: antigen presentation by macrophages → cytokines released by T-helper cells → B-lymphocyte differentiation

C.text: antigen presentation by neutrophils → T-memory cell activation → B-lymphocyte selection

D.text: T-memory cell activation → B-memory cell activation → antibody production
